purpose: Example schema for future few-shot prompt examples. This file contains placeholders only and must not contain real private PDF text unless explicitly approved for local-only use.

few_shot_policy.preferred_example_type: small row or table snippet with expected strict JSON output
few_shot_policy.leakage_warning: PDFs or pages used as few-shot prompt examples must be excluded from benchmark scoring unless explicitly labeled as training/few-shot cases.

examples.input_excerpt: <small OCR/text/table snippet, not an entire PDF>
examples.mapping_notes: Concept IDs are optional for few-shot normalization examples. Do not teach the extractor to invent taxonomy mappings.
examples.why_this_is_a_good_example: Use only if it demonstrates a recurring OCR/table/sign pattern clearly.
caution_notes: Do not evaluate few-shot improvements on this exact page unless it is labeled as a training/few-shot case.

examples.input_excerpt: <small table snippet with current and prior year columns>
examples.mapping_notes: If mapping examples are added later, keep them separate from extraction normalization examples.
examples.why_this_is_a_good_example: Use only if it clearly teaches year/column handling.
caution_notes: Exclude this page from holdout scoring if used in a prompt.
Keep at least 3-5 other PDFs/pages as holdout evaluation cases.
